content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert - continuous-batch tail latency spike in eu-west-1 cluster. 90th->99.9th +8x, p50 stable. auto-pager fired. thread start ts=2358129447

Jia (oncall): ack'ing pager. pulling traces and kv-cache dashboards. marking impacted routes.

Mike_SRE: I see queue length on runtime-0x32 jumping and kvcache.evictions spiking. looks like cache working set explosion -> batch pileup.

Leo_runtime: confirming metrics. per-shard entries ~120k -> ~1.2M in ~7m. eviction throughput can't keep up -> cold misses up -> microbatch sizes inflate -> inflight queues grow.

Jia (oncall): customer impact: several mid-market tenants on dedicated pools saw 5xxs + streaming stalls. hosted customers saw elevated token latencies. no data lost.

Mike_SRE: checking deploys... no runtime deploys in last 2h. found config change: continuous_batch.batch_window_ms increased 8->40ms in config-service 30m ago. candidate root cause.

Leo_runtime: that would cause larger microbatches at high qps. combined with prefetch heuristics, we can get feedback: larger batches -> bigger KV working set -> more evictions -> more misses -> longer queues -> more batching.

Jia (oncall): live mitigations plan:
1) revert batch_window_ms to 8ms for eu-west-1 via config-service rollback
2) enable degen-mode for continuous-batch on affected pools (force small max_batch_size)
3) increase kvcache.eviction_throttle to 0.9 temporarily to accelerate reclaim
4) apply quick rate-limits on noisy tenant routes to shrink blast radius

Mike_SRE: I'll roll the config rollback now. who can flip degen-mode and throttle without restarts?

Olivia_infra: I can flip the flag for pools pool-eu-12 and pool-eu-13. API call ready: `/api/v1/flags/set?flag=continuous_batch.degen_mode&value=true&scope=pool-eu-12,13`

Olivia_infra: also routing a small reserve: diverting ~10% traffic to spare nodes for those pools while we stabilize.

Jia (oncall): executing rollback: 
```
curl -XPOST https://config-service/api/v1/overrides \\n  -d '{"path":"continuous_batch.batch_window_ms","value":8,"scope":"eu-west-1"}'
```

Mike_SRE: config change applied at 2358129652. seeing microbatch size distribution shift down, queue length trending down.

Olivia_infra: degen-mode enabled at 2358129670. kvcache.eviction_throttle set to 0.9 at 2358129685. reserve routing in place.

Jia (oncall): customer hits: three tenants had >10% 5xxs between 2358129400-2358129800. support notified and proactive messages sent.

Support-Bot: created INC-4621 (acme-corp), INC-4622 (lumen-ai), INC-4623 (glidepay). assigned to CS-Ops.

Mike_SRE: observing ~60% reduction in tail latency after degen-mode. backlog draining over ~6m. throughput back to acceptable levels. continuing monitoring.

Leo_runtime: hypothesis: config rollout increased batch_window -> larger microbatches under concurrency -> KV working set expands -> eviction cascade -> runtime doesn't shrink batches fast enough -> perf cliff.

Mike_SRE: short-term mitigations done. next actions: implement adaptive backoff so batch_size contracts when eviction_rate high, add circuit-breaker to fallback to microbatching earlier.

Jia (oncall): follow-ups assigned:
- Leo_runtime: implement adaptive batch_backoff in runtime (P0, include canary)
- Olivia_infra: add automated rollback guard in config-service for batch_window_ms changes >+5ms without canary
- Sarah_next_oncall: take over monitoring + customer comms for next 2h
- Mike_SRE: lead post-incident triage + initial timeline

Sarah_next_oncall: taking handoff. I'll update every 30m and coordinate CS. ping me to escalate. :thumbsup:

Jia (oncall): handing off at 2358130100. left notes in incident doc: https://internal/incidents/2358129447

Mike_SRE: quick postmortem notes to add:
- timeline + relevant metrics attached to incident doc
- config-rollout id cfg-2026-04-18-78 (author 2358129405)
- flag flip id flag-993
- affected pools: pool-eu-12, pool-eu-13
- customer tickets: INC-4621, INC-4622, INC-4623

Leo_runtime: will push hotfix branch to throttle prefetch and set target kvcache.max_shard_items=200k. will link PR here when ready.

Olivia_infra: recommend sweep across regions to detect similar drift; scheduling quick job and will report.

Sarah_next_oncall: I have the handoff and will drive customer comms. aiming for postmortem draft within 48h. owners assigned.

Mike_SRE: closing pager — mitigations successful. keeping thread open for docs & follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
